text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her attention on medium-distance races, Sakura Bakushin O secretively conducts research on two of her peers, Rice Shower and Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a thorough assessment, Sakura Bakushin O successfully pinpoints the two's capabilities. However, her self-analysis is lacking in comparison. She has a tendency to run wild with passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm at a complete loss for a strategy to deal with this flaw of hers.
